About

Incorporated in 1994, Tata Technologies Limited is a global engineering services company offering Product Development and Digital Solutions.[1]

Key Points

Business Verticals:
a) Services (77%):[1]
The company offers Engineering, Research & Development (ER&D) services, which include product design, simulation, testing, and embedded systems development, primarily serving the automotive, aerospace, and industrial sectors.
b) Technology Solutions (23%):[2] [3]
The company offers Digital Enterprise Solutions (DES), focusing on IT services like ERP, CRM, analytics, and product lifecycle management (PLM), and reselling third-party software and delivering technology solutions for academia upskilling and reskilling.
